contract: v7 medulla timing DATA PIN: the non-motion mV recordings used to fit (training) and test (held-out) the v7 arm. Frozen before any v7 fit or simulation.
owner_rules: Per-type parameters only; fitted only to NON-MOTION recordings of input or medulla cells upstream of T4/T5; never gratings, direction selectivity or behaviour; no invented or changed edges; held-out data separate; calcium is not an mV target without an observation model.
data_root: <data-root>/flybrain-v7-medulla-data-20261010 (local only; nothing under it is redistributed)

primary.citation: Behnia R, Clark DA, Carter AG, Clandinin TR, Desplan C (2014) Processing properties of ON and OFF pathways for Drosophila motion detection. Nature 512:427-430. doi 10.1038/nature13427; PMID 25043016; PMCID PMC4243710 (NIH author manuscript nihms642361)
primary.released_numbers: No raw traces, filters or source data were released (PMC 'has-supplement no'; Europe PMC hasSuppl N; Nature 2014 Letter has no Source Data). Released scalars, from the text: filter peak times Mi1 71 ms (s.e.m. 3.8, N=7), Tm3 53 ms (5.2, N=11), Tm1 56 ms (3.8, N=15), Tm2 43 ms (2.7, N=14); weak/strong polarity ratios (Extended Data Fig. 1c) Mi1 OFF/ON 11 % (3.5, n=7), Tm3 36.6 % (7.1, n=10), Tm1 ON/OFF 26.1 % (3.8, n=10), Tm2 17.7 % (2.3, n=11).
primary.recording: in vivo whole-cell current clamp of medulla somata (Multiclamp 700B), awake immobilised flies (sex not stated) 1-2 d after eclosion, room temperature, GAL4>GFP-guided; 0-5 pA hyperpolarising holding current to bring V near -60 mV (responses unchanged between -50 and -60 mV). One cell per fly. 'Tonic' Mi1 (65 %) and Tm3 (18 %) excluded by the authors as non-physiological.

training.what: Fig. 3b (Mi1, Tm3) and Fig. 3e (Tm1, Tm2): average linear temporal filters +/- s.e.m., units mV contrast^-1 ms^-1
training.stimulus: 10 s full-field Gaussian flicker q(t)=m(1+s(t)), s.d. 50 % contrast, exponential correlation time 10 ms, 240 Hz DLP, q bounded to [0, 2m]; mean radiance 1.1 W sr^-1 m^-2 (~250 cd m^-2); screen 55x55 mm at 40 mm. NON-MOTION (spatially uniform).
training.processing: 60 Hz notch; 0.008 Hz high-pass; K(w)=<R S*>/(<S S*>+eps), 5 s zero-padded snippets every 0.1 s, eps = 1 % of mean <S S*> (Baccus & Meister 2002); filter = inverse FFT.
training.validation_of_digitisation: digitised mean-filter peak times 70/56/54/44 ms vs the text's mean peak times 71+/-3.8, 53+/-5.2, 56+/-3.8, 43+/-2.7 ms (all within 1 s.e.m.)

heldout.what: Fig. 2 (1 s full-field flash from dark): onset and offset peak deflections (mV) per type; plus the Extended Data Fig. 1c ratios released in the text
heldout.stimulus: dark -> light (intensity 1 on the 0-1 scale of the flicker, i.e. 2m) for 1 s -> dark; NON-MOTION. Different stimulus class from training (flashes from darkness vs flicker about a mean).
heldout.validation_of_digitisation: digitised weak/strong ratios 11/34/27/18 % vs the text's 11/36.6/26.1/17.7 %
heldout.independence: same lab, preparation and probably overlapping animals; independent of the training data in stimulus, not in animal

primary.digitiser: scripts/v7/digitise_behnia2014.py (method, calibration constants and uncertainty in its docstring): curve = mean row of trace-colour pixels per column; s.e.m. band = contiguous tint run; lag 0 = the y-axis line; 50 ms = 39+/-1 px; y 0.5 = 119 px. Uncertainty: y 1 px = 0.0042 mV contrast^-1 ms^-1, time +/-2 ms, scale +/-2.6 %; Fig. 2 amplitudes +/-0.2 mV +/-2.3 %.
primary.licence: Article (c) Macmillan/Springer Nature 2014; the PMC author manuscript is 'available for text mining' and usable 'consistent with fair use'. Figure images and digitised numbers are kept local under <data-root>, pinned by sha256, and are NOT committed or redistributed; the repository holds only the digitiser and the hashes. Scalar numbers quoted from the text are cited facts.
primary.refuted_use: The Mi1/Tm3 and Tm1/Tm2 filter pairs are NOT used as delay-and-correlate constants (refuted 1-2 in the 8 Oct deep research). v7 fits per-type membrane/release parameters so that each recorded cell's OWN filter, measured inside the unchanged network, matches.

checked_not_used.Arenz_2017: Arenz A et al. Curr Biol 27(7), 2017, doi 10.1016/j.cub.2017.01.051. Two-photon CALCIUM imaging (GCaMP6f) of the columnar T4/T5 inputs. Calcium, no v7 observation model -> not an mV target; no released data located.
checked_not_used.Serbe_2016: Serbe E et al. Neuron 89(4), 2016, doi 10.1016/j.neuron.2016.01.006. Two-photon CALCIUM imaging of Tm1, Tm2, Tm4, Tm9 (white-noise filters, RFs). Calcium -> not an mV target.
checked_not_used.Drews_2020: Drews MS et al. Curr Biol 30(2), 2020, doi 10.1016/j.cub.2019.10.035. CALCIUM imaging of motion-circuit neurons, contrast compression by surround; adaptation, not a timing target. Not used.
checked_not_used.Ramos-Traslosheros_2021: Ramos-Traslosheros G, Silies M. Nat Commun 12, 2021, doi 10.1038/s41467-021-24986-w; data G-Node GIN doi 10.12751/g-node.qeeyfz (GRamosT/off-motion-receptive-fields), data CC BY-NC 4.0, code BSD-3. CALCIUM (GCaMP6f/jRGECO1a) dF/F of Tm1, Tm2, Tm4, Tm9, CT1, T5; contains MOVING sinewave epochs (motion: must be excluded if ever used). Not downloaded; LOCAL USE ONLY, never redistributed. Not an mV target.

unpinned_gaps: No non-motion mV recording pinned for Mi4, Mi9, Tm4, Tm9, C3, CT1 or the lamina in this arm; their v6 parameters are inherited unchanged.
